skills.name: Common-denominator subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract numerators directly once both fractions share the same denominator.

skills.name: LCD conversion
skills.definition: Find the least common denominator of two unlike fractions and rewrite both as equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Whole-part subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract the whole-number parts of two mixed numbers or integers.

skills.name: Borrowing/regrouping
skills.definition: When the fractional subtraction yields a negative value, borrow 1 from the whole part (expressed as d/d) and recompute the fraction subtraction.

skills.name: Simplify fraction
skills.definition: Reduce a resulting fraction to its lowest terms when it is not already fully reduced.

skills.name: Common denominator conversion
skills.definition: Find the LCD for two fractions with unlike denominators and convert each to an equivalent fraction over that denominator.

skills.name: Same-denominator fraction subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators of two fractions (or fraction parts) that already share a common denominator to get their difference.

skills.name: Mixed number decomposition
skills.definition: Separate a mixed (or whole) number into whole and fractional components, subtract the whole parts, and recombine the whole and fraction results into the final answer.

skills.name: Borrowing/regrouping
skills.definition: When the fraction-part subtraction yields a negative value, borrow one unit from the whole part (as denominator/denominator) and redo the fraction subtraction.

skills.name: Whole-number-as-fraction rewriting
skills.definition: Rewrite a bare integer operand as 'n + 0/d' so it can be aligned and subtracted against a fraction or mixed number with denominator d.

skills.name: Fraction simplification
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction (intermediate or final) to lowest terms by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common factor.

skills.name: Improper mixed-number normalization
skills.definition: Convert a mixed number whose fractional part is improper (numerator ≥ denominator) into standard form by carrying the excess into the whole part before subtracting.

skills.name: Common denominator conversion
skills.definition: Find the LCD of two unlike denominators and convert both fractions to equivalent fractions over that denominator.

skills.name: Numerator subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators of two fractions that already share a common denominator to obtain the fraction-part result.

skills.name: Whole-part subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract the whole-number parts of two mixed numbers (or a mixed number and an integer) independently of the fraction parts.

skills.name: Borrowing/regrouping
skills.definition: When the subtrahend's fraction part exceeds the minuend's, regroup one whole unit as denominator/denominator into the fraction part and decrement the whole part before subtracting.

skills.name: Simplify to lowest terms
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction result by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common divisor when it is not already in lowest terms.

skills.name: Normalize improper mixed-number fraction
skills.definition: Convert a mixed number whose fraction part's numerator is greater than or equal to its denominator into standard proper mixed-number form before performing the subtraction.

skills.name: Common-denominator subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators of two fractions that already share the same denominator, keeping the denominator unchanged.

skills.name: Find LCD and convert
skills.definition: Determine the least common denominator for two fractions with unlike denominators and convert both to equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Subtract whole-number parts
skills.definition: Separate the whole-number part(s) of mixed numbers (treating a bare whole number as having a zero whole or zero fraction as needed) and subtract the whole numbers independently of the fraction parts.

skills.name: Borrow/regroup between whole and fraction
skills.definition: When subtracting the fraction parts would give a negative result (or a mixed number's fraction part is improper), regroup one whole unit as denominator/denominator with the fraction part and adjust the whole part, repeating if necessary.

skills.name: Simplify to lowest terms
skills.definition: Reduce a resulting fraction (or the fractional part of a mixed number) to lowest terms by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common factor.

skills.name: Same-denominator numerator subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators of two fractions (or fractional parts of mixed numbers) that already share a common denominator.

skills.name: Common denominator conversion
skills.definition: Find the LCD of two unlike denominators and convert both fractions into equivalent fractions with that denominator before subtracting.

skills.name: Whole/fraction decomposition and recombination
skills.definition: Separate an operand into whole and fractional parts (treating a bare whole number as whole+0/d when needed), subtract the whole parts, and recombine the whole and fraction results into the final answer.

skills.name: Borrowing/regrouping
skills.definition: When subtracting the fractional parts produces a negative value, regroup one unit from the whole part as d/d and redo the fraction subtraction (repeating if necessary).

skills.name: Simplification to lowest terms
skills.definition: Reduce the resulting fraction by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common divisor to express the final answer in lowest terms.
